aria: Animated recap of the Nuggets' 116 to 108 road win over the Pelicans: Christian Braun's 3-pointer off a Jamal Murray pass with 3:32 left, right after his steal, that made it 109 to 96, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Nikola Jokić's 26 points and 10 assists, the top scorers, how the Nuggets won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from the Nuggets' 116–108 win over the New Orleans Pelicans at Smoothie King Center on Nov 14, 2026, from the CBS Sports box score and play-by-play, with game details from Denver Stiffs, the Associated Press (headlines via The Washington Post and TalkBasket) and The Standard. All 116 Denver points and all 108 New Orleans points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (29–27–30–30 to 23–28–31–26) add up to both totals: 56–51 Denver at the half and 86–82 after three, matching Denver Stiffs. Two-pointers made (38–24) are field goals made minus threes made from the box score (42 of 80 and 4 of 16 for Denver, 37 of 89 and 13 of 33 for New Orleans); free throws (28 of 37 to 21 of 33), assists (29–25) and steals (9–6) are box-score totals, and bench points (27–42) are summed from the box score. Denver's biggest lead, 15 at 102–87 with 6:38 left, and New Orleans' only lead, 3 points early in the first quarter, are from the CBS play-by-play. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Saturday's games: Denver 7–4 and seventh in the West, New Orleans 4–10.

Denver opened the fourth quarter on a 9–0 run, from 86–82 to 95–82 at 9:11 (CBS play-by-play), with Marvin Bagley III scoring three of the points (CBS; Denver Stiffs). The Nuggets finished a four-game road trip 3–1 (Denver Stiffs). Jokić had 26 points, 10 assists and 8 rebounds and Murray 23 (AP; The Standard; box score). It was New Orleans' sixth straight loss (AP via The Washington Post; TalkBasket). Denver hosts Phoenix on Monday, Nov 16 at 9:00 PM ET, and New Orleans hosts Golden State the same night (site schedule).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Christian Braun's 3-pointer off a Jamal Murray assist with 3:32 left that made it 109–96, 22 seconds after Braun stole Herb Jones' pass at 3:54 (CBS play-by-play); Denver Stiffs also describes Braun's three with under four minutes left. The shot itself isn't described further, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Denver Nuggets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Christian Braun's listed 6-foot-6 and 220 pounds (Wikipedia), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-6½ wingspan at the 2022 NBA draft combine (Kansas City Star via Yahoo), in Denver's road colors with No. 0 (Wikipedia). He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
